#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <fstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <queue>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <stack>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int MAX_SIZE = 1 << 20;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;
const ll W = 646LL;
ll W_ARR[MAX_SIZE];
ll W_INV_ARR[MAX_SIZE];
ll SIZE_INV;

ll modPow(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            result = (result * base) % mod;
        }
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

ll modInverse(ll a, ll mod) {
    return modPow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

class DataBuffer {
public:
    long long buffer[MAX_SIZE];
    
    DataBuffer(long long input[]) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            buffer[i] = input[i];
        }
    }
    
    void transform(bool forward) {
        recursiveDFT(0, 1, forward);
    }
    
private:
    void recursiveDFT(int start, int step, bool forward) {
        if (step == MAX_SIZE) {
            return;
        }
        recursiveDFT(start, step * 2, forward);
        recursiveDFT(start + step, step * 2, forward);
        
        int half = MAX_SIZE / (step * 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            long long twiddle = forward ? W_ARR[i * step] : W_INV_ARR[i * step];
            long long even_val = buffer[start + i * step * 2];
            long long odd_val = buffer[start + i * step * 2 + step];
            
            long long t1 = (even_val + twiddle * odd_val) % MOD;
            long long t2 = ((even_val - twiddle * odd_val) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
            
            buffer[start + i * step * 2] = t1;
            buffer[start + i * step * 2 + step] = t2;
        }
    }
};

class FastScanner {
private:
    FILE* file;
    char buffer[1024];
    int pos, len;
    
public:
    FastScanner(FILE* f) : file(f), pos(0), len(0) {}
    
    string nextLine() {
        char line[10000];
        if (fgets(line, sizeof(line), file) == NULL) return "";
        string s(line);
        if (!s.empty() && s[s.size()-1] == '\n') s.erase(s.size()-1);
        if (!s.empty() && s[s.size()-1] == '\r') s.erase(s.size()-1);
        return s;
    }
    
    string nextToken() {
        while (true) {
            if (pos >= len) {
                len = fread(buffer, 1, sizeof(buffer), file);
                pos = 0;
                if (len == 0) return "";
            }
            while (pos < len && isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
            if (pos >= len) return "";
            
            int start = pos;
            while (pos < len && !isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
            return string(buffer + start, buffer + pos);
        }
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stoi(token);
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stoll(token);
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stod(token);
    }
};

class FFT {
private:
    FastScanner* scanner;
    ofstream* writer;
    bool useSystemIO = true;
    
    vector<long long> computeDFT(vector<long long>& input) {
        int n = MAX_SIZE;
        vector<long long> output(n, 0);
        long long wPower = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long long x = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < input.size(); j++) {
                output[i] = (output[i] + input[j] * x) % MOD;
                x = (x * wPower) % MOD;
            }
            wPower = (wPower * W) % MOD;
        }
        return output;
    }
    
    vector<long long> exponentiate(vector<long long>& arr, int exponent) {
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) {
            arr[i] = modPow(arr[i], exponent, MOD);
        }
        return arr;
    }
    
    void process() {
        int n = scanner->nextInt();
        int k = scanner->nextInt();
        vector<long long> values(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx = scanner->nextInt();
            if (idx < 10) values[idx] = 1;
        }
        
        vector<long long> transformed = computeDFT(values);
        transformed = exponentiate(transformed, n / 2);
        
        long long input_arr[MAX_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            input_arr[i] = transformed[i];
        }
        
        DataBuffer buffer(input_arr);
        buffer.transform(false);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            transformed[i] = (buffer.buffer[i] * SIZE_INV) % MOD;
        }
        
        long long result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            result = (result + transformed[i] * transformed[i]) % MOD;
        }
        
        *writer << result << endl;
    }
    
    void initialize() {
        if (useSystemIO) {
            scanner = new FastScanner(stdin);
            writer = new ofstream("CON");
        } else {
            scanner = new FastScanner(fopen("input.txt", "r"));
            writer = new ofstream("output.txt");
        }
        process();
        if (writer) {
            writer->close();
            delete writer;
        }
        delete scanner;
    }
    
public:
    FFT() {
        // Precompute W_ARR and W_INV_ARR
        W_ARR[0] = 1;
        W_INV_ARR[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
            W_ARR[i] = (W_ARR[i - 1] * W) % MOD;
            W_INV_ARR[i] = (W_INV_ARR[i - 1] * W) % MOD;
        }
        
        // Compute SIZE_INV = MAX_SIZE^(-1) mod MOD
        SIZE_INV = modInverse(MAX_SIZE, MOD);
    }
    
    void run() {
        initialize();
    }
};

int main() {
    FFT fft;
    fft.run();
    return 0;
}
